subject: Problem with some input components on bootstrap page

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Problem with some input components on bootstrap page
parts:
I am trying to construct a bootstrap page with a dateInput

shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  tags$head(
    tags$link(rel = 'stylesheet', type = 'text/css', href = 'styles.css')),
   
  
  div( class="intro", 
       dateInput("date", "Date:", value = today)
  ))

This results in the dateInput wrapped in an, undesired, standard div, within the div(class="intro")
A similar result occurs with, say, sliderInput whileas helpText and checkboxInput appear 
as wished
Is there anyway round this?

cheers
andrew clark

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Problem with some input components on bootstrap page
parts:
The standard div is currently necessary to make the control work. This is a hack, but...

di <- dateInput("date", "Date:", value=today)
di[[2]]$attribs$class <- paste(di[[2]]$attribs$class, "intro")

...would add "intro" to the dateInput div's class. Another way to go would be to modify your CSS to refer to #date instead of .intro.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Problem with some input components on bootstrap page
parts:
Hi Andrew - if you're not using the latest development version, try updating to that. There have been some changes since dateInput was first implemented a few weeks back.

It now uses the current date on the client as the starting value, if 'value' is not specified. One drawback to using something like dateInput(..., value = Sys.date()) is that it will use the current date on the server, which may differ from the date on the client due to time zone differences. Also, I believe that ui.r will be run once and the output will be cached; that means that if you have an app that runs for more than a day, it will still keep printing out the start date even when new users connect. You could work around this by using updateDateInput() from server.R. But it's easier to just leave the date unspecified and let the client figure it out.


Regarding the wrapper div issue: I'm just curious, why is it a problem when there's a wrapper div?

-Winston
